title: Foraging Finds Map and Seasonality
dataSources: Fishing catches (`fishing:catch`), fishfinder sonar (`fishfinder:reading`), foraging finds (`foraging:find`), game-cam triggers (`gamecam:trigger`).
app: Outdoor logs — fishing apps (Fishbrain), sonar / fishfinder exports, game/trail cameras, and foraging journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=foraging:find
| eval month=strftime(_time,"%B")
| stats count as finds, values(location) as spots by species month
| sort species
description: Logs your foraging finds by species, spot, and month, learning the seasonal calendar of your patch.
value: Foraging rewards memory of where and when things grow; a logged calendar makes your patch pay off year after year.
implementation: Ingest foraging finds into `index=personal`; summarise by species and month.
visualization: Table of foraging finds by species and season.
grandmaExplanation: It logs where and when you find wild mushrooms and plants, learning your patch's seasons.
